get.description: Search the 'Default' Acumatica Endpoint for a Specific Entity

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The top-level entity to retrieve. Example: "Project" or "User"

schema.description: The top-level entity to retrieve. Example: "Project" or "User"

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Use the expand parameter to specify linked and detail entities that should be expanded. By default, no linked or detail entities are expanded; that is, only fields of the top-level entity are returned. You need to explicitly specify each linked or detail entity to be expanded. (Example: to expand the Project Attributes use $expand=Attributes).
